$comment: The Form & Force mark: two strokes travelling the same way. The upper one draws the form and ends in a fine, lifted tip; the lower one carries the force down to a point at the baseline. Together they make an F in motion. Traced from brand/source/storyboard.png (the hero lockup, checked against the stacked lockup) and redrawn as cubic Béziers with smooth joins. Change it only by re-tracing the storyboard; brand/guidelines/logo.md lists what must not change.

light.$comment: The finish gradient runs from the foot of the force stroke to the tip of the form stroke.
